Marketing.headline: A clean monorepo base for reliable WhatsApp AI operations.
Marketing.subheadline: The repo now ships with a Turbo workspace, a localized Next.js shell, a Cloudflare Worker ingress shell, and shared workspace packages prepared for the later Convex, Clerk, and WhatsApp phases.

cards.foundationBody: Single repo with apps and packages wired for phase-by-phase delivery.
cards.i18nBody: next-intl is initialized with locale-aware routing from day one.
cards.ingressBody: Hono and Wrangler are in place with local, staging, and production placeholders.

Marketing.shellFootnote: Later phases will replace placeholders with Clerk auth, Convex persistence, webhook verification, queue orchestration, and production observability.

Dashboard.headline: The tenant dashboard now ships with auth, Bot Studio, Knowledge Base, WhatsApp setup, and live webhook ingress.
Dashboard.subheadline: The repo has moved past shell-only delivery. Tenancy, localized bot configuration, markdown-first knowledge ingestion, encrypted WhatsApp setup, and signature-safe raw webhook durability are now in place.

botStudio.title: Bot Studio
botStudio.body: Prompt, language, model, safety, and preview controls are active.

knowledgeBase.title: Knowledge Base
knowledgeBase.body: Inline and website knowledge now ingest into markdown chunks and embeddings.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.body: Inbound conversations now drive bot orchestration state, outbound queue visibility, and failure surfacing.

ops.title: Ops
ops.body: Queue visibility, webhook state, and monitoring expand across phases 6 to 14.

checklist.repo: pnpm workspace and Turbo remain the repo backbone.
checklist.web: Next.js App Router, Tailwind, and next-intl power the localized dashboard.
checklist.ingress: Ingress now verifies Meta signatures, rate limits by phone number, and durably stores raw webhook events before exiting.
checklist.shared: Convex auth, RBAC, Bot Studio, Knowledge Base, WhatsApp setup, and inbound transcript persistence are wired end to end.

Dashboard.nextStepsBody: Phase 9 adds outbound sending through Meta, retry handling, and status reconciliation.

BotStudio.headline: Bot Studio
BotStudio.subheadline: Configure the tenant-scoped bot profile, localized prompts, provider settings, and run emulator previews through the AI draft runtime.

BotStudio.exampleMessage: Hello, is this business open on Sunday?

KnowledgeBase.headline: Knowledge Base
KnowledgeBase.subheadline: Store markdown-first business knowledge, chunk it, embed it, and feed the emulator with tenant-scoped retrieval.
KnowledgeBase.missingRuntime: NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL is not configured. Knowledge Base needs a Convex deployment before sources can be queried or ingested.
KnowledgeBase.title: Title

WhatsAppSetup.headline: WhatsApp Integration Setup
WhatsAppSetup.subheadline: Store the active tenant WhatsApp identifiers and credentials safely, keep raw secrets off the frontend, and expose the exact webhook target needed for Meta setup.
WhatsAppSetup.missingRuntime: NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL is not configured. WhatsApp setup needs a Convex deployment before the integration state can load or save.
WhatsAppSetup.configureBotFirst: Configure Bot Studio first. WhatsApp integration is linked to the active tenant bot profile.
WhatsAppSetup.accessTokenPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the current encrypted access token
WhatsAppSetup.appSecretPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the current encrypted app secret
WhatsAppSetup.verifyTokenPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the current hashed verify token
WhatsAppSetup.keepSecretHint: Secret fields stay blank after save. Leaving them empty keeps the current encrypted or hashed values in storage.

Inbox.headline: Inbox
Inbox.subheadline: Review inbound WhatsApp conversations, bot orchestration state, outbound send attempts, delivery status reconciliation, service-window timing, and media processing from one tenant-scoped inbox surface.
Inbox.missingRuntime: NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL is not configured. Inbox data needs a Convex deployment before conversations can load.
Inbox.empty: No inbound conversations yet. Once WhatsApp webhook messages are normalized, they will appear here.
Inbox.expiringSoon: Service window is close to expiry. Prepare a template fallback if needed.
Inbox.noMedia: No media records have been queued yet.
